rubric_content.text_property: Every order id, SKU, location and quantity in the response comes from a tool result in this conversation.
If the request was ambiguous or a tool asked for clarification, the response asks the user instead of choosing an option.

asks_when_reference_asks.description: If the reference answer asks a question, the agent's answer must ask one too. Deterministic, no judge.

no_tool_calls_beyond_reference.description: Every tool the agent called appears in the reference trajectory; an empty reference allows no calls. Deterministic, no judge.
